passive.name: Battle Fury
passive.description: Tryndamere gains Fury for each attack, critical strike, and killing blow he makes. Fury passively increases his Critical Strike Chance and can be consumed with his Bloodlust spell.

primaryAbilities.name: Bloodlust
primaryAbilities.description: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: Tryndamere thirsts for blood, gaining up to {{ maximumbonusad }} Attack Damage based on his missing Health.

Active: Tryndamere consumes his Fury, restoring {{ baseheal }} plus {{ healperfury }} Health per Fury (max: {{ maximumheal }}). {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Mocking Shout
primaryAbilities.description: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Tryndamere hurls insults, reducing champions' Attack Damage by {{ adreduction*-1 }} for {{ reductionduration }} seconds and <status>Slowing</status> by {{ slowpotency*-100 }}% while cowering from him for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Spinning Slash
primaryAbilities.description: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Tryndamere spins through his enemies, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and generating {{ nonchampfurygain }} Fury per enemy hit, increased to {{ champfurygain }} Fury against enemy champions.

This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by {{ nonchampcdrefund }} seconds when Tryndamere critically strikes, and reduced by {{ champcdrefund }} seconds when critically striking a champion.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Undying Rage
primaryAbilities.description: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Tryndamere becomes completely immune to death for {{ tryndrduration }} seconds, refusing to be reduced below {{ tryndrminhealth }} Health, and instantly gains <keywordMajor>{{ tryndrfurygain }} Fury</keywordMajor>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by [0.75] seconds when Tryndamere critically strikes, and reduced by [1.5] seconds when critically striking a champion.

allSpellRecords.name: Battle Fury
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues:
Tryndamere's Attacks grant him 5 Fury or 10 Fury for a critical strike, and 10 Fury for killing a unit. After 8 seconds of being out of combat, Tryndamere loses 5 Fury every second.

Each point of Fury grants [0.5]% Critical Strike Chance.

allSpellRecords.name: Undying Rage
allSpellRecords.summary: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues: Tryndamere becomes completely immune to death for [5] seconds, refusing to be reduced below [30 / 50 / 70] Health, and instantly gains [50 / 75 / 100] Fury.

allSpellRecords.name: Mocking Shout

allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues: Tryndamere hurls insults, reducing champions' Attack Damage by [(-20 / -35 / -50 / -65 / -80) × -1] for [4] seconds and Slowing by [(-0.3 / -0.35 / -0.4 / -0.45 / -0.5) × -100]% while cowering from him for [3.25] seconds.

allSpellRecords.name: Bloodlust

Passive: Tryndamere thirsts for blood, gaining up to [20 / 35 / 50 / 65 / 80] Attack Damage based on his missing Health.

Active: Tryndamere consumes his Fury, restoring [30 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 70 + (0.3) × AP] plus [0.5 / 0.95 / 1.4 / 1.85 / 2.3 + (0.012) × AP] Health per Fury (max: [30 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 70 + (0.3) × AP + (1 × AbilityResource(4, statFormula=default)) × ((0.5 / 0.95 / 1.4 / 1.85 / 2.3 + (0.012) × AP))]).
